title: Quick Double Fried Polish Chicken Noodles
description: A savory and pillowy Polish dish featuring chicken bouillon powder, double-fry KFC style, and flexitarian-friendly ingredients, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, chicken bouillon powder, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each piece of chicken into the flour mixture, coating evenly, then double-fry in the hot oil until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the oil and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, double-fried chicken, and sauteed onion and garlic mixture.
Serve the Quick Double Fried Polish Chicken Noodles in a mason jar and enjoy!
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
